captions.detailed: A 3D model of a Civil War 3-inch ordnance rifle, featuring a dark grey wrought-iron barrel mounted on a brown wooden trail carriage. The barrel is supported by a central axle structure and is flanked by two large, black iron-spoked wheels. The carriage tapers to a narrow rear trail, and the barrel pivots vertically on its trunnions while the wheels rotate on their axles.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a Civil War 3-inch ordnance rifle using CadQuery. The model should include a dark grey iron barrel, a brown wooden trail carriage, and two large black iron-spoked wheels mounted on a central axle, with revolute joints allowing the barrel to tilt and the wheels to spin.
captions.factory: Construct the main carriage chassis by combining extruded wooden cheeks and a central trail block using CadQuery. Model the barrel as a tapered cylinder lofted or unioned with a breech sphere, adding cylindrical trunnions on either side. Build the wheels by combining a central hub cylinder, thin cylindrical spokes arranged radially in a loop, and a thin outer rim, then assemble these parts on a transverse axle cylinder using revolute joint definitions.
